text: [83] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca katamehi pañcahi kuhako ca hoti lapako ca nimittiko 3 ca nippesiko ca lābhena lābhaṃ nijigiṃsitā ca imehi kho .pe. pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca katamehi pañcahi na ca kuhako hoti na ca lapako na ca nimittiko na ca nippesiko na ca lābhena lābhaṃ nijigiṃsitā imehi kho .pe. #1 yu. palāsī . 2 po. cāti . 3 ma. nemittiko . yu. nemittako .
